name: first_hold_250
comment: First powered roll-harness run (approved by Loren 2026-11-04): flown default gains, 250 permille collective, lift off the stop, hold level, one 3 deg attitude step, STOP. 11-04 PM: max_run_ms 7000 -> 10000 because the runner now waits out the FC lift-off window (RIG_LIFTOFF_TIMEOUT_MS + 0.3 s after RUN) before the first EXC; the plan needs 9.1 s armed. RUNMS above the approved 7 s needs Loren's OK.
